title: Rainy Harbor
description: A rainy fishing harbor where three residents repair boats and trade fish.

actors.name: Eel
actors.goal: Repair nets and spare parts quickly

memories.text: The rain makes wood swell, so I check hull seams before dawn.
I trade fish only after checking weights and freshness.
I keep rope and floats sorted to mend nets faster.
